legal.draftNotice: This is a first draft describing how the site actually works. It needs legal review before an official launch, and it does not claim full legal compliance.

sections.title: What the platform is
body: Najdat Al-Tariq 24 is an intermediary that connects owners of broken-down cars with independent service providers (mechanics and electricians, battery, tyres, towing and more). The platform does not do the repair itself; the provider is responsible for their work.

sections.title: Prices and offers
body: The platform does not set fixed prices. Each provider sends an offer showing the callout and inspection fee, labour, parts, the total in Syrian pounds, and how long the offer is valid.
When you accept an offer we keep a copy of it and the time you accepted, and the agreed price cannot be changed afterwards.
If the offer says so, the callout and inspection fee is due once the provider arrives and inspects the car, even if you decline the repair. You see and accept this before accepting the offer.
Any extra cost after inspection (parts, a battery, a tyre, a larger repair) is sent to you through the platform and is only added to the amount after your explicit approval.

sections.title: Payment
body: Payment is cash, directly to the provider. There is no online payment at the moment.
A request is not completed on the provider's word alone, but after you confirm the work is done and paid. If the two sides disagree, our team reviews the request.

sections.title: Cancellation
body: You can cancel for free before the provider arrives. After arrival our team steps in. There are currently no cancellation fees, and the cancellation policy in force is shown before you confirm any request.
If the provider drops out before arriving, your request automatically goes back to finding another provider.

sections.title: Providers
body: Providers register their details and documents and receive no request before our team reviews and approves them. This review reduces risk but is not a full guarantee of the quality of work.
Providers commit not to add any fee without the customer's approval and to update the request status honestly. We may suspend any account that breaks this.
The platform is currently free for providers (zero commission). If a commission is introduced, it is announced in advance in the provider panel and never applies to past requests.

sections.title: Ratings and complaints
body: A provider can only be rated after the request is completed, once per request. The ratings shown are real; we do not show fake ratings or numbers.
Either side of a request can file a complaint about it, and our team reviews it.

sections.title: Limits
body: We try to connect you with a suitable provider, but we cannot guarantee one is available at every time and place. When no one is available, we tell you so clearly.

sections.title: What we collect
body: Customers: phone number, the car's location (or a landmark description), car details and a description of the problem, and any photos you choose to upload. We may ask for an ID photo depending on platform settings.
Providers: name, phone, a personal photo and an ID document, work and area details, and for tow trucks: vehicle details, photos and proof of ownership.

sections.title: Who sees your data
body: Candidate providers see only the governorate, an approximate distance, the car and the problem. The exact location, phone number and photos are shown only to the provider whose offer you accept, and only while the job is active.
ID documents, personal photos and tow truck ownership documents are seen only by authorised staff, and every view is logged.
The tracking link is secret. Anyone with it can see the status only; offers, actions and the provider's number require signing in with your phone.

sections.title: How we store it
body: Files are stored encrypted in private storage, with hidden location data stripped from photos, and are never published at public links.
We do not record verification codes or document contents in system logs.
The map is loaded from OpenStreetMap servers, so they receive your device's address when the map is shown.

sections.title: Retention and deletion
body: We keep data as long as we need it to provide the service and handle complaints. Files uploaded without completing a request are deleted periodically. You can ask us to delete your documents.

sections.title: Contact
body: For any question about your data, contact us on the numbers at the bottom of the site.
